020import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
021import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
022
023import java.util.Map;
024import java.util.Optional;
025
026/**
027 * EconomyManager
028 *
029 * @author creatorfromhell
030 * @since 6.2.0.11
031 */
032public interface EconomyManager {
033
034  /**
035   * Retrieves a map of all economies associated with their unique identifier.
036   *
037   * @return A map containing integers as keys and EconomyProvider objects as values.
038   */
039  Map<String, EconomyProvider> providers();
040
041  /**
042   * Set the EconomyProvider for this manager.
043   *
044   * @param provider The EconomyProvider to be set for this manager.
045   */
046  void provider(final @NotNull EconomyProvider provider);
047
048  /**
049   * Retrieves an Optional instance of EconomyProvider associated with the given id.
050   *
051   * @param id The unique identifier of the EconomyProvider to retrieve.
052   *
053   * @return An Optional instance containing the EconomyProvider if found, or an empty Optional if
054   * not found.
055   */
056  Optional<EconomyProvider> provider(final @NotNull String id);
057
058  /**
059   * Uses the provided EconomyProvider associated with the specified provider ID.
060   *
061   * @param id The unique identifier of the EconomyProvider to be used.
062   */
063  void useProvider(final @NotNull String id);
064
065  /**
066   * Retrieves the current EconomyProvider.
067   *
068   * @return The current EconomyProvider, or null if not set.
069   */
070  @Nullable
071  EconomyProvider provider();
072}
